name: Can weatherproofing help reduce my energy bills?

mainEntity.name: Can weatherproofing help reduce my energy bills?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, effective exterior wall weatherproofing can significantly reduce your energy bills. By sealing cracks, gaps, and porous surfaces, it prevents uncontrolled air infiltration and exfiltration. This minimizes heat loss in cooler months and heat gain in warmer months, reducing the workload on your HVAC system. A well-sealed building envelope means your heating and cooling systems operate more efficiently, consuming less energy. This not only saves money but also contributes to a more comfortable and consistent indoor temperature.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, weatherproofing reduces energy bills by preventing air leaks, minimizing heat loss or gain, and allowing your HVAC system to operate more efficiently.
